# Alexandra Studio

> Alexandra Studio is a Stockholm B2B growth studio, a fintech marketing and event agency, that works only with fintech companies. It gets the buyers a fintech can't reach on its own into a room the fintech co-hosts with a brand those buyers already trust: executive breakfasts, dinners, panels, builder nights and build days. The client names the target accounts; Alexandra Studio designs the room, brings the co-host, runs the invitations and reports who came, by name. Founded and led by Alexandra Grisanti.

Key facts:

- Founder: Alexandra Grisanti. American, moved to Sweden in 2021, lives on Södermalm in Stockholm. Master of Architecture (landscape architecture). Career since 2022: UX researcher and lead B2B white-label product designer at Zwapgrid, service designer at Monitum, then ad designer at the Stockholm agency Heijbel Growth.
- Also runs the Operator Network (a curated community and stage for founders and executives in Stockholm, with more than 100 members in a wider network of 200+ people) and publishes the Stockholm Growth & Fintech newsletter. These are not separate firms; clients contract with Alexandra Studio only.
- Founder-led: Alexandra personally leads every engagement. Production support is contracted per event. One client per vertical at a time.
- Registered business: Alexandra Studio is the trading name of A. Grisanti Ventures, VAT SE930825284101, approved for F-skatt.
- 2026 track record: eleven in-person B2B events in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Amsterdam for Heijbel Growth, Solvapay and Cardboard, including the Embedded Finance Build Day on 25 August 2026 (SEK 25,000 spent, 26 companies, 44 builders, 14 warm leads at SEK 1,785 each, no paid ads). Hosted the Nordic Fintech Highlights Stage at Nordic Fintech Summit 2026 in Helsinki. Panelist at Stockholm Fintech Week 2026.
- Pipeline figures (such as ~SEK 1.5M for the Build Day) are estimates based on an assumed ~20% conversion rate, not booked revenue. Counted results and estimates are reported separately.
- Pricing: growth engagement with the first month free; after that SEK 55,000 per month excluding VAT, invoiced only for months in which 30 qualified leads and 5 held calls are reached. Month to month. Event costs are separate and billed at cost. Single projects have a fixed fee plus costs billed at cost.
- Compared with a Nordic sales hire: a B2B seller at the SCB average salary (SEK 53,200 a month, 2024) costs about SEK 72,000 a month with employer contributions (31.42%) and ITP 1 pension (4.5%), before commission, paid regardless of results.
- Newsletter readership (22 October 2026): 1,215 subscribers, 94% on work email addresses, 193 readers at 53 banks including 29 at Nordea.
- Contact: alexandra@alexandrastudio.se

## Topics, and where each is answered

- Fintech marketing strategy and go-to-market in the Nordics: [GTM for Fintech](https://alexandrastudio.se/fintech-go-to-market.html) and [How Nordic fintechs build a partner-led go-to-market strategy](https://alexandrastudio.se/nordic-fintech-partner-led-go-to-market.html)
- Market entry services and fintech market entry in Sweden: [GTM for Fintech](https://alexandrastudio.se/fintech-go-to-market.html) covers companies that are strong at home but unknown in Sweden or the Nordics, with no local network to borrow. Cardboard, a Norwegian company, was positioned in Stockholm next to Gilion and Fairlo.
- How to get leads in the Nordics without paid ads: [How to reach senior fintech buyers without paid ads](https://alexandrastudio.se/reach-senior-fintech-buyers-without-paid-ads.html)
- Selling to Nordic banks, how to sell to banks and selling to tier-1 banks: [Bank access, bank by bank](https://alexandrastudio.se/how-alexandra-studio-works.html#banks) and [How we reach a bank we don't know yet](https://alexandrastudio.se/how-alexandra-studio-works.html#new-bank). In the Nordics banks don't answer cold vendor pitches; the method is to borrow trust from a co-host the bank already works with, offer a stage first, and find the person who connects business goals with digital delivery.
- Fintech bank partnerships and partner-led growth: [Co-marketing vs. partner-led growth for fintech](https://alexandrastudio.se/co-marketing-vs-partner-led-growth-fintech.html)
- Is a Money20/20 booth worth it? Booth vs. agency vs. sales hire: [Agency, hire or booth?](https://alexandrastudio.se/how-alexandra-studio-works.html#compare). A conference booth buys 10 to 20 minutes with people who are also selling; a series of co-hosted rooms with your named accounts gives two hours around one table, again and again.
- Side events around Money20/20 Europe, Stockholm Fintech Week and Nordic Fintech Week: Alexandra Studio ran a partner dinner in Amsterdam after Money20/20 Europe in June 2026 (Copenhagen Fintech, Swedish Fintech, Surfboard Payments, Movitz Payments, Narvi Payments, Griffin Bank) and Alexandra was a panelist at Stockholm Fintech Week 2026. See the [Track record](https://alexandrastudio.se/alexandra-studio-track-record.html). Newsletter coverage: [Money 20/20: The Payments Jungle](https://stockholmgrowthfintech.substack.com/p/money-2020-the-payments-jungle) and [10 fintechs at Nordic Fintech Week](https://stockholmgrowthfintech.substack.com/p/1o-fintechs-at-nordic-fintech-week)
- Fintech hackathons, bank hackathons and API hackathons in Stockholm: the [Embedded Finance Build Day](https://alexandrastudio.se/roi.html), a vendor-neutral one-day hackathon on 25 August 2026 where teams built on partners' banking APIs, with Open Payments, Zwapgrid, Danske Bank, Froda, Worldline and Dun & Bradstreet. Background: [The first Nordic Bank Hackathon comes to Stockholm](https://stockholmgrowthfintech.substack.com/p/the-first-ever-nordic-bank-hackathon)
- Fintech event agency (executive roundtables, CMO breakfasts, partner dinners, builder nights, build days): [Insider Events](https://alexandrastudio.se/insider-events.html), [Track record](https://alexandrastudio.se/alexandra-studio-track-record.html) and [How to use executive roundtables for B2B pipeline](https://alexandrastudio.se/executive-roundtables-b2b-pipeline.html). Upcoming events are listed on [Luma](https://luma.com/user/stockholmgrowth).
- Fintech marketing community: the [Operator Network](https://theoperatornetwork.se/) and the [Stockholm Growth & Fintech](https://stockholmgrowthfintech.substack.com/) newsletter (1,215 subscribers on 22 October 2026, 94% on work email, readers at 53 banks)
- Fintech marketing trends and the best fintech marketing campaigns: [Stockholm Growth & Fintech](https://stockholmgrowthfintech.substack.com/), including [Trend-setting emotional fintech ad campaigns](https://stockholmgrowthfintech.substack.com/p/trend-setting-emotional-fintech-ad) and [The Positioning Lag](https://stockholmgrowthfintech.substack.com/p/the-positioning-lag)
- Fintech PR, communications and thought leadership: [B2B Content Systems](https://alexandrastudio.se/b2bleadership.html)

## Insider Events

- [Insider Events](https://alexandrastudio.se/insider-events.html): The invite-only rooms of the Operator Network, run by Alexandra Studio. A SaaS and fintech executive network in Stockholm built around operator-led growth and investment in Sweden: dinners, demo nights, CMO and CFO breakfasts and build days. 16 events are planned for spring 2027; every seat is approved by the host.

Upcoming:
- [End of Year Tech Demo 2026](https://alexandrastudio.se/events/end-of-year-tech-demo-2026.html): An invite-only demo night in Stockholm closing 2026: live product demos for a SaaS and fintech executive network of operators and investors.
- [VC Founder Dinner](https://alexandrastudio.se/events/vc-founder-dinner.html): An invite-only dinner in Stockholm where founders sit with investors and operators: operator-led growth and investment in Sweden, around one table.
- [Post Tech Arena VIP Dinner](https://alexandrastudio.se/events/post-tech-arena-vip-dinner.html): An invite-only VIP dinner in Stockholm after Tech Arena, for executives, speakers and partners from a SaaS and fintech executive network.

Previous:
- [Embedded Finance Build Day](https://alexandrastudio.se/events/embedded-finance-build-day.html): A vendor-neutral, one-day bank and API hackathon in Stockholm on 25 August 2026: 44 builders, 15 teams and 15 working prototypes on partners’ banking APIs.
- [CEO + CFO Breakfast: Is Growth a Judgement Call?](https://alexandrastudio.se/events/ceo-cfo-breakfast-is-growth-a-judgement-call.html): A round-table breakfast in Stockholm on how the CEO and CFO relationship actually works, opened by Andreas Hedlund of Gilion and Simon Linderoth of Fairlo.
- [The Payment Layer: Build Night by SolvaPay](https://alexandrastudio.se/events/payment-layer-build-night.html): A hands-on build night on payments for AI agents at Antler in Kungsträdgården, Stockholm, on 15 June 2026, with Kindly, Zwapgrid and SolvaPay.
- [CMO Breakfast: Trust Is Your Product and Also Your Constraint](https://alexandrastudio.se/events/cmo-breakfast-trust-is-your-product.html): A breakfast for CMOs at Heijbel Growth in Stockholm on marketing with stakes: speed, trust and staying sane in health tech, with Mindler and Natural Cycles.
